description_en: You can invoke ListHistoricalAgentReport to obtain the Historical Data report for one or more agents under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalAgentReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个坐席的历史数据报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-historical-agent-report --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --agent-id-list agent1@ccc-test_,_agent2@ccc-test --start-time 1532448000000 --stop-time 1532707199000 --instance-id ccc-test --media-type VIDEO --skill-group-id wwtest@test_yunhu --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHistoricalAgentReport

parameters.help_en:
List of agent IDs, containing 0 to 100 entries.

> If the agent ID list is not empty, the query is performed directly based on the provided agent ID list. In this case, the pageSize and pageNumber parameters are invalid, and the data is returned directly. For example, if the request parameter is pageNumber = 3, then the response parameter will also be pageNumber = 3
parameters.help_zh:
坐席ID列表，范围0-100 。

> 如果坐席ID列表不为空，则直接按照坐席ID列表进行查询，此时pageSize和pageNumber参数无效，数据直接返回，如：请求参数：pageNumber = 3 则响应参数中pageNumber = 3
parameters.name: agent_id_list

parameters.help_en: Start time of the historical data to retrieve. The default value is 00:00 of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time. Time is rounded down to the nearest hour for statistical purposes, using a closed interval. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，默认为当天的0时，最早为当前时间往前180天。统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End Time of the Historical Data to retrieve. The default value is the current time. The time precision for statistics is in hours, snapped backward to the nearest hour, forming an open interval. For example, if the Start Time is 11:12:20 and the End Time is 11:45:50, the snapped input parameter Time Range becomes \[11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，默认为当前时间。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为 11:12:20，结束时间为 11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为 [11:00:00, 12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: stop_time

parameters.help_en: Media type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type
